paths.name: 144 side seam
paths.hypothesis: Two exposed cyan portions across the side seam versus shading within one portion; endpoints avoid the bright left highlight. Ignore the lower extension.

paths.name: 189 central to right cyan
paths.hypothesis: Connect broad central and right cyan portions across the dark side edge. The right portion is a neighboring image region, not an asserted chain neighbor. Avoid the lower continuation.

paths.name: Cyan to red near 189
paths.hypothesis: Exposed cyan and red interiors separated by an oblique color edge; apparent image neighbors, no chain relationship assigned.

paths.name: 144 central shading control
paths.hypothesis: Path inside the apparent central face, away from the side seam; single-body status is a visual hypothesis.

paths.name: Front red to red
paths.hypothesis: Adjacent broad red faces separated by a curved overlap edge; path below first highlight and above second.

paths.name: Front cyan to cyan
paths.hypothesis: Two staggered cyan faces across an overlap edge; endpoints below their highlights.

paths.name: Front white to cyan
paths.hypothesis: Broad white face above a cyan face; cyan highlight lies beyond the candidate seam along the same path.

paths.name: Inside red through highlight
paths.hypothesis: Both endpoints lie in the same apparent red face; a white highlight is inside it, not a separate bead. Initial end x=366 was in the highlight shoulder; moved to x=369 after raw-image review. No independent validation claim.

paths.name: Inside cyan through highlight
paths.hypothesis: Both endpoints lie in the same apparent cyan face; cross the internal highlight.

paths.name: Inside cyan toward shadow
paths.hypothesis: Shaded lower part of the same apparent cyan face, with endpoint kept above its lower seam.

paths.name: Rejected: start in shadow stripe
paths.hypothesis: Initial B was intended to connect two interiors but starts in the very shadow stripe under examination. Retained as a failed placement example, not negative seam evidence.

limitations: All endpoint identities and local views are visual hypotheses selected from the JPEG, not renderer truth.
Straight paths are descriptive measurements, not fitted boundaries or a validated classifier.
Offsets translate both endpoints; they do not exhaust independent endpoint or curved-path uncertainty.
Inspect full corridors against the silhouette; saved masks are not a body-identity oracle.
No source pattern, renderer ownership, fragment ownership or chain indexing is used.
